chapters.title: Live Sale: Search the item, check quantity and price
chapters.text: This is Live Sale. Find the item in Search, and check the quantity and the price.

chapters.title: Who is it for? Then tap the red ✓
chapters.text: Say who it is for: a G M number, a phone number, a name, or a short label. Then tap the red tick, and the sale goes into the Sales Log.

chapters.title: WIC = a sale. GMC = shop use. Several items = MI
chapters.text: When one customer buys several items, tap M I and add each to the basket. Company law: every walk-in sale goes in Live Sale with W I C on. G M C is only for the shop's own use, and it is not a sale. A customer buying several items is sold through M I: one basket, one receipt. Breaking it costs one penalty point. It exists so that every sale is recorded and every receipt is complete.

chapters.title: Wrong sale? Undo it in the Sales Log
chapters.text: If you record a sale by mistake, undo it in the Sales Log. Law: receipts are issued from M I or the Sales Log, never typed into Customer Receipts. A sale the app refuses, such as a price below cost or not enough stock, is not forced: tell Joe. Breaking it costs one penalty point. A receipt typed by hand, or a forced sale, makes the books untrue.

chapters.title: Past days: + Past sale and the right date
chapters.text: Law: past days are entered only with plus Past sale and the right sale date. The same work is never typed twice. Breaking it costs one penalty point. Wrong dates break the daily figures, and then the Sales Log cannot be trusted.

chapters.title: 🚩 Flags: every problem on this page, and how many
chapters.text: Now, flags. A flag is the app telling you a record is wrong. Every flag on Live Sale is in the Flags dropdown, with how many are open.

chapters.title: Pick a flag: what it means, why, and the steps
chapters.text: Pick a flag, and a strip under the toolbar says what it means, why it matters, and the steps to clear it.

chapters.title: Follow the steps: tap the item, Edit, price, Save
chapters.text: Follow the steps. Tap the item, tap Edit, type the selling price, and tap Save. The flag clears at once.

chapters.title: Law: fix every flag as soon as it appears
chapters.text: This is company law: every flag on Live Sale is fixed as soon as it appears. It is never left for the next day, and never hidden by editing the item to make it disappear. Breaking it costs two penalty points. Open flags make prices wrong and stock untrue, and the real problem becomes harder to find.

chapters.title: The Daily Checklist asks about flags 3 times a day
chapters.text: Three flag checks are company law, and each costs one penalty point. Morning flag check: open Flags on Live Sale. Every open flag is fixed now, using the steps shown. Answer all good, or report what you could not fix. Afternoon flag check: open Flags on Live Sale and fix any new flag. Answer all good, or report what you could not fix. Closing flag check: no Live Sale flag is left open. Answer all good, or tell Joe which flag is still open and why. They exist so that no flag survives the day.

chapters.title: Item list: every good in the right group
chapters.text: Law: once a week, item groups are checked: every good is in the right group. Breaking it costs one penalty point. Reports, filters and counts all depend on the group, and a wrongly grouped item hides in the wrong report.

chapters.title: Prices: everyone sells at the current price
chapters.text: Law: once a month, the price list is checked: it is current, and every staff member has it. Breaking it costs one penalty point. A wrong price loses money on every sale of that item.

chapters.title: Know the words: SOH, SP, CP, WIC, GMC, CAB
chapters.text: Law: app words. S O H is stock on hand. S P is selling price. C P is cost price. W I C is walk-in customer. G M C is Grony Multimedia as customer. C A B is cash at bank. Search the Handbook before asking. Breaking it costs one penalty point. A misunderstood word becomes a wrong entry.

chapters.title: Everything for this page: 📜 Laws
chapters.text: Everything about this page, the laws, the sanctions, why each law exists, and how to do things, is on the Laws button, with this video and its written transcript. Tap any line to jump to that part.

chapters.title: Sign each law. Penalty points: the owner approves
chapters.text: Every law on this page has a code, and you sign each one to show you have read it and will follow it. Breaking a law costs penalty points: twenty is a three day suspension, thirty is one week, and fifty is dismissal. The owner approves every sanction.
